note: Obfuscate Email hides emails via ROT13 (with @->/at/, .->/dot/) plus a shared vanilla-JS reveal (library obfuscate_email/default). Two entry points: a text-format filter plugin obfuscate_email (TYPE_TRANSFORM_REVERSIBLE, settings click + click_label; config filter.format.<id>.filters.obfuscate_email) and a field template field__email / field--email.html.twig for fields named field_email (with a rot13 Twig filter). No configure route, no permissions, no Drush. Medium cases create text format oe_test_format with the filter enabled (click_label OE_CLICK_SENTINEL) and inspect it. Hard cases enable the filter on an existing format (hard-1) and build a new click-to-reveal format (hard-2), verified against filter.format config.

evals.prompt: How does the obfuscate_email module hide an email address from spam bots, and how does the real address get shown to a normal visitor?
evals.expected_output: The address is scrambled server-side with str_rot13() after replacing '.' with /dot/ and '@' with /at/, and stored in a data-mail-to attribute (the visible text is blanked to @email and the href set to #). A vanilla-JS behaviour (Drupal.behaviors.obfuscateEmailField, library obfuscate_email/default, attached to every page) reverses the ROT13 and the /at//dot/ substitutions in the browser and restores the mailto: link. There is no non-JavaScript fallback.

evals.prompt: I want email addresses typed into CKEditor body text to be obfuscated on output. Which obfuscate_email feature do I use, where do I turn it on, and what options does it have?
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'Obfuscate Email' filter (id obfuscate_email, a TYPE_TRANSFORM_REVERSIBLE filter) on the relevant text format at Configuration » Content authoring » Text formats and editors. It rewrites mailto: anchors in the processed text. Options: 'click' (require a click to reveal) and 'click_label' (the reveal link text). Stored under filter.format.<id> -> filters.obfuscate_email.

evals.prompt: Besides the text filter, obfuscate_email ships a field template. Which theme hook / template file is it, and which field does it automatically obfuscate?
evals.expected_output: hook_theme() registers the field__email theme hook using templates/field--email.html.twig (base hook 'field'), so it renders — and obfuscates — any field whose machine name is field_email. It uses the module's rot13 Twig filter and the same /at//dot/ scheme, emitting data-mail-to markup that the shared JS reassembles.

evals.prompt: This site has a text format named oe_test_format with the Obfuscate Email filter enabled and configured to require a click. Inspect the live configuration and report the exact 'Text to show on link' (click_label) value.
On this site, which text format currently has the obfuscate_email filter enabled? Inspect the live filter format configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: The oe_test_format text format has filters.obfuscate_email.status = true.

evals.prompt: This site has a text format named oe_task_format that does not yet obfuscate emails. Enable the obfuscate_email filter on that text format and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In filter.format.oe_task_format the obfuscate_email filter has status: true (e.g. via FilterFormat::load('oe_task_format')->setFilterConfig('obfuscate_email', ['status' => TRUE])->save()).

evals.prompt: Create a new text format called 'oe_secure' (machine name oe_secure) that hides email addresses and forces visitors to click a link reading 'Reveal' before the address is shown. Save it on the live site.
evals.expected_output: A FilterFormat 'oe_secure' exists with filters.obfuscate_email enabled (status true) and settings click: true, click_label: 'Reveal'.
